literal: Like the eye-shield upon a rutting male elephant is the fine cloth upon the firm breasts of this beautiful woman.
translation: The fine cloth covering the firm breasts of this beautiful woman is like the protective eye-shield draped over a fierce, rutting elephant.
modern: மதங்கொண்ட ஆண் யானையின் மேல் அணியும் கண்மறைப்புத் துணி போன்றது, இந்தப் பெண்ணின் நிமிர்ந்த மார்பகங்களின் மேல் அணிந்துள்ள மெல்லிய ஆடை.
explanation: In this couplet, the hero compares the garment covering the heroine's breasts to the protective eye-shield (கட்படாம்) of a rutting elephant (கடாஅக் களிறு). A rutting elephant is wild and dangerously powerful; similarly, the beauty of the heroine's breasts is overwhelmingly intense and capable of causing sweet torment to the beholder. The fine cloth (துகில்) acts as a shield, partially veiling this immense power and protecting the onlooker from being completely overcome. The word 'படாஅ' describes her breasts as firm and unconquered, mirroring the untamed strength of the 'கடாஅ' (rutting) elephant.
